description: Structure of the run report written by agent000 only (app/instance/runs/<run_id>/report.json, referenced in sup_runs.totals) and of the result envelope every agent returns.

fields.summary: One paragraph computed by the program (no model).
fields.tasks_other: skipped / not_run / partial tasks with their reason
fields.quality: named check outcomes of the run
fields.limits: what was NOT verified in this run (disabled sources, missing config...)
fields.digest: daily chain only: top offers and offers to review
